$description: Architecture decision record for Obrenna agent orchestration. Every runtime component reads this file to determine models, tools, permissions, and streaming configuration without hardcoding values.

orchestrator.description: Primary reasoning and planning role. Produces <think> CoT blocks that must be filtered before UI display.

summarizer.description: Evidence-pack folding and rolling-summary updates. Never routes reasoning.

utility.description: Worker tasks: fact extraction, JSON shaping, validation. Fast and deterministic.

allowed.name: get_time
allowed.description: Return local system time and timezone offset.

allowed.name: calculator
allowed.description: Evaluate a sandboxed arithmetic expression. Never eval, AST execution, or JS Function.

allowed.name: file_read
allowed.description: Read file contents by resolved file ID or allowlisted path. Reject arbitrary absolute paths.

allowed.name: web_search
allowed.description: Return search snippets with source URLs only. No full-page fetch.

allowed.name: get_location
allowed.description: Return current geographic location. Routes through Rust permission broker.
